correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 and every F_m<=n<F_(m+1), signed Fibonacci convergent vectors give a unimodular lattice basis. The sign-and-index argument excludes any orbit point strictly between the two Fibonacci predecessors of the new point; the resulting gap splits into lengths alpha^(m-1),alpha^m. This covers all n (including the n=1 wrap special case). Shannon entropy changes by C alpha^(m-2). Direct Binet summation gives the closed entropy formula. The full scaled accumulation sets follow by Binet asymptotics and sequences n_m/F_m->t in [1,phi]. The strict convexity of G establishes both extremal defect values. The standalone verify.py checks 2000 exact-field gap splits with maximum floating log discrepancy below 6e-14, plus a separate direct-gap finite check for n<=119; finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.
